subject: Request: additional prep time + access before demo
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: additional prep time + access before demo

Hi Sarah / Tom,

Quick note on the demo we have on the calendar for Fri, Oct 3. I ran the plan by our engineering team this morning and we need a little extra time to stage some customer-specific prompt sets and upload workload traces so the demo reflects ACME's traffic patterns. Also, several of our folks will be traveling that day.

Would you be open to moving the demo to the week of Oct 6 (we're proposing Oct 8) so we can:
- ingest a representative sample of your traces
- stage the prompt/response sets you shared
- provision a short-lived sandbox/API token for the dry run

Can you also confirm the best way for you to share sample traces (S3 path or Drive link)? If it's easier we can provide a temporary S3 upload location.

Attached: demo-checklist.pdf (brief checklist of what we need)

Thanks—happy to be flexible, just want to make sure the session is useful for your execs.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: demo-checklist.pdf (pdf, 72KB)]

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: 2025-10-01T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional prep time + access before demo

Thanks for the heads up, Jordan.

On Wed, Oct 1, 2025 at 9:12 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick note on the demo we have on the calendar for Fri, Oct 3...

We actually have an executive all-hands travel that morning, so Oct 3 won't work. Oct 8 would be better for us, but late afternoon (after 1pm PT) is preferable because of scheduling on our side.

We'll share a representative corpus and a small sample of traces via Drive by EOD today — I'll drop a link in a follow-up. For the sandbox, we prefer to upload to an S3 path (we can grant read-only access) but I need to check with ops about short-lived credentials.

If you can do a quick 20–30 minute pre-demo sync (remote) the morning of Oct 8 to confirm environment/setup, that would help.

Appreciate the flexibility.

—Sarah
Sarah Liu
Director of AI Platforms
ACME Corp

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-02T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional prep time + access before demo

Thanks Sarah — that's great.

We can do Oct 8 and will target an afternoon slot that works for your execs. Two options from our side: Oct 8 at 1:00 PM PT or Oct 9 at 2:00 PM PT. Please let us know which you prefer and we'll update the invites.

Operational asks from our side to make the demo valuable:
1) A short sample of traces (1–5k rows) uploaded to either:
   - s3://acme-sample-traces/2025/demo/ (read access for redwood-demo@redwood.com)
   - OR a Drive folder we can pull from (Drive link or shared file)
2) Any PII/sensitive columns removed or a quick note on redaction rules
3) A list of 3–5 prompt/response examples you want us to exercise (open text)
4) If you have a sandbox/tenant we can use, a temporary API key or IAM role with read-only access for the dry run

We can run a 20–30 minute pre-demo sync the morning of Oct 8 (we suggest 9:00 AM PT) and a full customer-facing demo at 1:00 PM PT if that works for you. Ben will own the dry-run and Marissa will coordinate invite updates.

Attached: sample-workload-traces.json (small synthetic slice), acme_sample_traces.csv (example format).

Drive upload is also fine — here's a folder we can use if you want to drop files: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFgH-demo

If you prefer to give an S3 ARN, we can confirm the exact IAM principal.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: acme_sample_traces.csv (csv, 45KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-03T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional prep time + access before demo

Thanks everyone — quick coordination note from Redwood ops.

I've tentatively moved the customer-facing demo to:
> Wed, Oct 8 · 1:00 PM – 2:00 PM PT (ACME Execs + Redwood)

Ben will run the dry-run on Tue, Oct 7 · 9:00 AM PT and I'll send a separate calendar invite for that.

Sarah — I've created a temporary sandbox token and a short-lived upload location for traces. You should see an ACL request from our demo infra (s3://acme-sample-traces/2025/demo/) — if you can grant read-only for redwood-demo@redwood.com for the demo folder that will work. If granting access will take ops time, feel free to upload to the Drive folder instead; we've set permissions so our infra can pull the files.

Attached: acme_sample_traces.csv (placeholder)
Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFgH-demo

We'll aim to run the morning dry-run and then the 1pm demo. Please let us know any final exec attendees so we can tailor the agenda.

Thanks — see you next week.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
